limitations: Descriptive sensitivity of saved personalization context to literal option reversal only.
No prediction results, prediction traces, labels, preference scores or ledgers were read.
No attribution of prediction flips, accuracy effects or causal model behavior.
Exact-span overlap is not token overlap: truncation boundaries can change an exact tuple even for highly overlapping text.
84 comparisons reuse14 underlying reversed-item pairs; they are not84 independent target observations.
Original sparse source condition only; richer source condition, raw and no-profile controls excluded.

metric_recipe.digest: SHA256 compact sorted-key JSON, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, UTF8
metric_recipe.exact_span_intersection_union: set cardinalities on exact passage tuples; duplicates count once
metric_recipe.no_normalization: Context, options and passage text receive no whitespace or Unicode normalization
metric_recipe.ordered_projection: tuple list in saved content.passages order
metric_recipe.pair_id_sha256: digest({'researcher_id': original researcher string, 'context_sha256': SHA256(raw context UTF8), 'option_text_sha256s': sorted SHA256 hashes of each raw option UTF8)}); no source_condition
metric_recipe.pair_key: researcher_id + exact context + sorted exact option strings; two distinct options and literal reversal required
metric_recipe.pair_orientation: ascending released item_id, solely for stable display
metric_recipe.projection_hash: digest ordered projections with document_id replaced by digest(document_id); start/end/text hash unchanged
metric_recipe.unordered_multiset: Counter of exact passage tuples, preserving duplicate multiplicity
